summary: Two-slice shared-contract follow-on (foundation→properties): W1 elevates additive OpenAPI and UML OCL vocabulary so InsufficientStockError is the named channel for sequential insufficient stock and race losers and non-negative available stock is checkable on sequential/contract paths; W2 depends_on W1 and delivers the concurrent last-unit property (≤1 hold, never-negative stock, race-loser InsufficientStockError, opaque-principal AuthZ) with remaining OCL/tests/impl plus bounded TLA+/TLC under formal/.
acceptance_of_whole:
Scenario: Concurrent last-unit safety is checkable end-to-end
  Given the inventory reservation service for clients
  When concurrent authorized opaque principals race for the last unit of a SKU and unauthorized callers attempt concurrent reserve
  Then available stock never goes negative for any checkable interleaving
  And at most one soft-hold is created when availableStock is 1
  And race losers fail with named InsufficientStockError and create no extra hold
  And unauthorized callers fail with UnauthorizedError without mutation (POL-OPAQUE-PRINCIPAL-AUTHZ)
  And openapi/openapi.yaml documents InsufficientStockError (and UnauthorizedError) on reserve additively
  And contracts/**/*.ocl and passing tests/contracts/** cover insufficient-stock / race-loser naming and non-negative stock
  And formal/**/*.tla (+ .cfg) is TLC-checkable for last-unit exclusivity and non-negative available stock
  And payments, multi-warehouse, full IAM, UI, notifications, backorders, durable shared DB productization, Alloy, TTL extend, and list-by-SKU aggregates are not required

human_gate.reason: ChangeBrief scope is explicit; open_questions are non-blocking deferrals to implement / formal cfg; foundation OpenAPI+OCL then concurrent property+formal maps cleanly to in_scope and success_criteria. Formal apply remains a later Phase 3 human gate, not this WorkPlan.

items.acceptance_criterion:
Scenario: Concurrent last-unit reserves yield at most one hold and never-negative stock
  Given a reservation service with a SKU whose available stock is one
  And concurrent authorized opaque principals racing to reserve that last unit
  When those principals request soft-hold reservations against that SKU concurrently
  Then available stock never goes negative for any checkable interleaving
  And at most one soft-hold is created
  And race losers fail with named InsufficientStockError and create no extra hold
  And unauthorized concurrent reserve attempts fail with UnauthorizedError without mutating stock or holds
  And a bounded TLA+/TLC model under formal/ is checkable for last-unit exclusivity and non-negative available stock
